input.quote: 14.9 Bankruptcy. The parties hereto agree that Corio, as a licensee of Commerce One's intellectual property, shall be afforded all of the protections afforded to a licensee under Section 365(n) of the United States Bankruptcy Code
input.rationale: No insurance obligation exists anywhere in the Agreement: the Miscellaneous section (14.1-14.10) runs from assignment to complete understanding with no coverage provision, the indemnification and limitation of liability sections are silent, and the only occurrence of \"insurance\" in the document is a deduction item in the net revenue definition (p0012). Commerce One supplies operations, consulting and engineering personnel who work in our hosted environment (Sections 13.1-13.3) and operates the MarketSite.net Service, so it is a services/hosting vendor that touches our and our Customers' data with no coverage backing its indemnities. We therefore insert a short clause at the fallback level (E&O USD 1,000,000; cyber/privacy USD 2,000,000) rather than the fuller preferred package, as the shortest change that satisfies the position.

proposal.summary: Insert a short insurance clause in Miscellaneous requiring Commerce One E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber/privacy cover of USD 2,000,000.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no insurance obligation even though Commerce One's personnel work in our hosted environment and its MarketSite.net Service handles transaction data, so we add our fallback insurance position: errors and omissions cover of at least USD 1,000,000 and cyber/privacy cover of at least USD 2,000,000.

ops.text: Insurance. Commerce One shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 and cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.

mappings.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
